title: lepidium mummenhoffianum
intro: Lepidium mummenhoffianum, commonly known as Mountain Pepper Cress, is a species of flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Pepper Cress include its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve symptoms of indigestion and bloating. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates and isothiocyanates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
